name: @voxgig/sekreto
description: Sekreto: one name for a secret, resolved down a chain of providers (env, dotenv, file, vault, AWS, GCP, Azure, 1Password, Doppler, Infisical, boru). The TypeScript implementation of the polyglot sekreto library.

scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm i && npm run build && npm test
scripts.repo-bump: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && node -e "console.log('bumped to v' + require('./package.json').version + ' (package.json only - commit via repo-tag / repo-release)')"
scripts.repo-tag: REPO_VERSION=`node -e "console.log(require('./package').version)"` && echo TAG: ts/v$REPO_VERSION && git commit -a -m ts/v$REPO_VERSION && git push && git tag ts/v$REPO_VERSION && git push --tags;
scripts.repo-publish: npm run clean && npm i && npm run repo-publish-quick
scripts.repo-publish-quick: npm run build && npm run test && npm run repo-tag && npm stage publish --registry https://registry.npmjs.org --access=public

author: Richard Rodger - richardrodger.com
